card.title: SAVOIA CAVALLERIA
card.flavorText: The Savoia Cavalleria Regiment (3rd) is one of the oldest cavalry regiments of the Italian Army, dating back to the 17th century. During WWII the Savoia Cavalleria Regiment was attached to the 3rd Fast Division "Principe Amedeo Duca d'Aosta" of the Italian Expeditionary Corps in Russia. The regiment earned its fame in what’s now called the Izbushensky Charge, which was a clash between the regiment and Soviet infantry. Col. Bettoni Cazzago, commander of the regiment ordered a cavalry charge with sabers drawn and hand grenades against two entrenched battalions of the 812th Siberian Infantry Regiment. The clash ended with an Italian victory, but there were heavy losses on both sides, and the outcome didn’t have much bearing on the Eastern Front. This event is however remembered as the last cavalry charges in history and it had great propaganda resonance in Italy at the time.
